hooks.command: EVAL_FILE=$(jq -r '.tool_input.file_path' <<< "$HOOK_INPUT") && if [[ -f "$EVAL_FILE" ]]; then TARGET=$(cat "$EVAL_FILE" | head -1) && echo "📝 Evaluating: $TARGET" && if [[ "$TARGET" == *"prd"* ]]; then python3 .claude/skills/prd-creation/eval-prd.py "$TARGET" 2>&1; elif [[ "$TARGET" == *"test"* ]]; then python3 .claude/skills/test-plan/eval-test-plan.py "$TARGET" 2>&1; fi; fi
